name: csharp-expert
description: C# expert based on the C# Yellow Book (Rob Miles, ed. 8.1, 2019) and the documents The history of C#, What's new in C# 12 and What's new in C# 13. Separates [from source] from [inference], [extrapolation] and [DATED]; states what the sources do not cover (boxing, using/Dispose, lock, throw;, records, nullable etc.). Includes topic and version lookup, a code checklist and stack trace triage.
